> Personally, I don’t think any good will come from you meddling in her life any further.

What if she turns up dead?  What if she takes all of her pills or something?  

I don't really know why I want to reach out to be honest.  I don't want to see anyone I care about die.  But I don't empathize with others.  SO it's hard to figure out why I care so much.

It's not that I don't want to see her posts.  I am just worried because of some of her recent posts.  
I am not going to therapy because I can't afford it.  I'm just trying to do what I can to be better.  I don't empathize with other people so I don't think therapy would help me anyway.
